== Examples

=== Table Insert (MySQL)


Here we insert rows into a database by populating the columns id, name and topic with values extracted from messages and metadata:

[source,yaml]
----
output:
  sql_insert:
    driver: mysql
    dsn: foouser:foopassword@tcp(localhost:3306)/foodb
    table: footable
    columns: [ id, name, topic ]
    args_mapping: |
      root = [
        this.user.id,
        this.user.name,
        meta("kafka_topic"),
      ]
----
